gen-gf-dekko-work-sans: Work Sans reads crisp and modern, with sturdy crossbars and a mean line set high. But Dekko's handwritten warmth is friendliest when the words are few, so brief copy suits it better than pages of text.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-fs-karma: Big, brash type over a quietly trustworthy page. Dela Gothic One shouts in wide, heavy letters while Karma, a serif with slight stroke contrast, keeps the eye moving smoothly.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-hind: Loose, friendly lettering: Delius Unicase has no tapering at the stroke ends and a pronounced x-height. And Hind, a sans with lowercase close to its capital height, follows along nicely, though it is happiest in modest amounts.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-sora: Relaxed and personal, Eagle Lake slims its joins gently while Sora, a geometric sans, keeps every curve free of any pressure swell. Reading goes best when the text stays brief.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-fs-epilogue: Graceful and relaxed, Euphoria Script keeps its letters close, while Epilogue draws curvy, tall-bodied, wire-like monoline lines beneath. Loose handwriting set against crisp wire is where the charm sits.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-fs-erode: Erode stands tall in the middle, with shallow ascenders and a broad aperture on the g and a. Erode eases along beneath Euphoria Script, which has no hairlines, and rewards brief reading.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-fs-hind: Relaxed and graceful, Euphoria Script leans on close-fitting, pen-drawn letters, set against Hind, a sans-serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals. Reading it feels light, and brief copy is its natural home.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-manrope: Graceful Euphoria Script brings relaxed, close-fitting handwriting to the top. It earns its keep large and brief, while Manrope, plainly drawn, holds one pen width and opens every curve.
gen-gf-expletus-sans-fs-rowan: Expletus Sans is distinctive and commanding, a display face with a plain, direct build. And Rowan, a friendly serif with generous curve openings, softens it, though long paragraphs are not its home.
